label: copy-phase input p (fed-back output p), late in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the input token is p, i.e. the model just output p and it is fed back (98.8% of activation mass is on in_tok = p; a small remainder is on in_tok = s). It never fires in the original phase or at <DEL>. Firing rate and magnitude rise sharply with position in the copy: almost nothing at recall_idx <= 3, and rate climbs from 0.2% at recall_idx 4 to about 2% at recall_idx 7-8, so most mass is in long sequences (L = 8-9) near the end of the copy. Among late copy-phase p inputs, it is stronger when the token being output next is also p (repeated pp in the original): the top activations are the first p of a pp pair. out_tok s/b/u also raise it a little. in_tok = p at copy position >= 4 covers 96% of activations, but only 28% of those steps fire; restricting to recall_idx >= 6 gives F1 of about 0.61 with 80% of mass. Many late p inputs stay silent, and adding conditions on the output token or on earlier p occurrences did not give a clean rule, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: p, s, u, b, -, k; least: y, m, v, j) and the token being output (most: p, s, u, b, r, k; least: c, -, 0, e); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=6, recall_idx=7, t=15.
